feedback: The proposed tests comprehensively cover the key requirements: left-to-right evaluation for operators of equal precedence, nested parentheses and precedence rules (multiplication/division before addition), and correct handling of terminating decimal fractions. Test R028-T01 validates left-to-right evaluation of addition and subtraction. Test R028-T02 verifies nested parentheses and correct precedence with multiplication and addition. Test R028-T03 ensures proper output of terminating decimal results. All tests align with the customer intent, use valid expressions, and match the expected outputs as per the mathematical reference checks. The test cases are well-justified and cover the core functionality without overreach. No missing or invalid cases are present.
